fact: ARCEP's third-quarter 2025 observatory reports that mobile operators and internet providers invested 29.8 billion FCFA by the end of Q3 2025, including Airtel (about 7.1 billion in Q3), Global Data Service (1.49 billion) and the state-owned Niger Telecoms (20.6 billion in September).
title: Observatoire des communications électroniques, troisième trimestre 2025
publisher: Autorité de Régulation des Communications Electroniques et de la Poste (ARCEP)
